name: Dassault Falcon 10 / 100
summary: A compact, nimble French business jet, the smaller sibling of the Falcon 20 and a popular choice for training and pilot-proficiency use.

wings: Low swept wing with plain tips
engines: Two Honeywell TFE731 turbofans on the sides of the rear fuselage
fuselage: Compact, small fuselage with a short row of small windows
tail: Swept fin with a low-set horizontal stabilizer (not a T-tail)

tellTales: Small swept-wing twinjet with engines blended into the sides of the rear fuselage
Compact body with small windows and plain wingtips

confusedWith.howToTell: The Falcon 20 is larger with more windows; the Falcon 10 is smaller with fewer windows.
The Lear has tip tanks, a T-tail and a pencil-slim body; the Falcon 10 has plain tips, a low tailplane and a rounder body.
The Citation I has a straight wing; the Falcon 10 has a distinctly swept wing.
The Beechjet 400 has a T-tail; the Falcon 10 has a low-set tailplane.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
